charts.name: neon-adapter
charts.responsibility: Compiled Proxy authentication, wake and storage observation adapter

charts.name: compute-management-gateway
charts.responsibility: Authenticated compute management and isolated DSGA credential broker

charts.name: neon-control-plane

charts.name: neon-compute
charts.responsibility: Retained static Compute VM, not Driver-created managed Computes

charts.name: data-api-gateway
charts.responsibility: Standalone Data API gateway, not Driver-created branch runtimes

charts.name: dsga-platform-qualifier

charts.name: dsga-qualifier-access

charts.name: dsga-runner-access
